video_caption: In this video segment, a woman with a yellow beanie, gold-rimmed glasses, and a black-and-white checkered scarf, wearing a grey jacket, is filming herself in a selfie style, speaking directly to the camera while walking. She smiles and gestures slightly as she talks. To her right, a modern storefront with large glass windows is visible; initially, part of a "ZARA" sign is obscured, then the full "ZARA" logo becomes clear. As she continues walking, a window display with a prominent vertical "SALE" sign in white letters against a black background comes into view, along with white, cylindrical display elements. On her left, a busy urban street scene unfolds, featuring a white delivery truck with "SAGAW A" printed on its side, a green and yellow taxi, and several pedestrians walking in the opposite direction.

In the video segment, a young person with short reddish-blonde hair, wearing a yellow beanie, round gold-rimmed glasses, a grey jacket, and a black and white checkered scarf, is shown from the chest up, looking directly at the camera and speaking. They have a slight smile and a nose piercing. A light blue backpack strap is visible on their left shoulder. The setting is an urban street lined with multi-story buildings, suggesting a shopping district. To the person's right, a "ZARA" store with large glass windows and mannequins is visible, followed by a blue vertical sign for "SKECHERS." On the left, there's a bus stop or shelter, and other pedestrians are walking in both directions, appearing slightly out of focus in the background. The lighting is bright but diffused, indicating an overcast day.

The video begins with a close-up of a young woman with fair skin, wearing round glasses, a yellow beanie, a grey coat, and a black and white checkered scarf, along with a nose piercing. She is speaking directly to the camera in a bustling urban environment, likely a street in Japan, as other people walk past in the background and various storefronts are visible; one store on the right features "SAKAZEN" signage and "SALE" posters. The scene then transitions to a geographical map of Japan, where the area around "Tokyo" is highlighted with a red rectangle, before zooming in further to show a detailed street map of the Tokyo area. This map eventually displays a specific walking route marked by a blue dotted line, originating from a red pin labeled "JRKS" and showing a "5 min" (5 minutes) and "400m" (400 meters) path in the vicinity of a red-highlighted "Shibuya" station area.

The video opens with a young woman, wearing a yellow beanie adorned with a Gudetama egg design, round glasses, a black and white checkered scarf, and a grey coat, recording herself while walking and talking on a busy city street with various buildings and signs, including one that reads "カラオケ" (Karaoke). She walks towards a modern glass building with a prominent red "JINS" logo on its facade. Inside the JINS store, she is seen in a reflection, holding her phone, with a "FLOOR GUIDE" visible on a glass partition displaying: "2F" (upstairs) with "受付" (Reception), "視力測定" (Eye examination), "お会計" (Cashier), and "待ち合い" (Waiting); and "1F" (downstairs) with "商品フロア" (Shopping floor) and "お受け取り" (Pick up). The store features neatly organized displays of numerous eyeglasses frames in different shapes and colors on light wooden shelves, alongside professional eye examination equipment. Her hand, adorned with rings, is shown picking up a pair of round, gold-rimmed glasses from a display. Finally, she interacts with a digital screen that allows for virtual try-ons, featuring her reflection wearing glasses and text prompts like "PLACE YOUR FACE IN THE CIRCLE".

The video opens with a person wearing a yellow beanie, checkered scarf, and grey jacket, holding a purple phone and looking at an interactive display. The display shows her face, virtually trying on glasses, then flashes "ERROR" multiple times, along with "JINS BRAIN" and options for "MAN" and "WOMAN," also showing "ERROR." Japanese text at the bottom reads, "ホームボタンを押さないで下さい (Please do not press the home button)." The person smiles and points at the screen, seemingly amused by the error. The scene transitions to a wide shot of a retail store, likely an eyewear shop, with numerous glasses frames displayed neatly on wooden tables. The camera then focuses back on the same person trying on various physical glasses: first a thin, round, light-colored frame, then a larger, clear/brownish rectangular frame, and finally a very large, dark, rectangular frame, each time showing different expressions. The video concludes with a close-up of two pairs of round, thin metal glasses frames on a wooden surface, one appearing rose gold (priced at ¥5000+税, which is approximately $73 AUD or $47.60 USD based on the overlaid conversion rate for ¥1000) and the other a lighter silver/gold (priced at ¥12000+税). A hand points at the prices, highlighting the difference, and then a third pink-rimmed, cat-eye style frame (also ¥12000+税) is brought into view, suggesting a decision-making process based on price and style.

In this outdoor urban scene, a woman with short, reddish-blonde hair wears a yellow beanie, gold-rimmed glasses, a gray jacket, and a black and white checkered scarf, facing the camera and speaking animatedly while making small gestures with her right hand. She is positioned slightly to the left, with an engaging and friendly expression. In the background, a busy street is visible with pedestrians, including one wearing a face mask, walking on sidewalks and crossing the street. A silver van is parked on the left. Dominating the background is a modern building with large glass windows, featuring a prominent red "JINS" sign, indicating an eyewear store. On the right side of the screen, text overlays appear, showing currency conversions: "¥1000 ≈ $14.60 AUD $9.52 USD (as of 03/2020)", which provides context for the prices she is discussing. The overall setting is a bright, daytime street in a city, likely in Japan.

A woman with a yellow beanie, glasses, and a black and white checkered scarf speaks directly to the camera from a bustling city street. She wears a grey coat and gestures with her right hand as she talks. Behind her, a large modern building with a glass facade displays "JINS" in red letters, and various people walk on the sidewalk and cross the street, while a silver van is parked nearby. The scene then cuts to a close-up of a wooden display board for "JINS J!NS SCREEN," showcasing three circular lenses designed to cut blue light. Japanese text above the lenses translates to "For your daily life tired by blue light. Protects you from blue light emitted from digital devices such as PCs and smartphones." The leftmost lens is labeled "自然な見た目で 日常使いにぴったり！ -DAILY USE- ブルーライトカット率 25%" ("Natural look, perfect for daily use! -DAILY USE- Blue light cut rate 25%"). The middle lens says "パソコン・スマホ 長時間使用する方に！ -HEAVY USE- ブルーライトカット率 40%" ("For those who use PCs/smartphones for a long time! -HEAVY USE- Blue light cut rate 40%"). The rightmost lens reads "安眠対策レンズ 寝る前スマホのお供に！ -NIGHT USE- ブルーライトカット率 60%" ("Sleep aid lenses for before-sleep smartphone use! -NIGHT USE- Blue light cut rate 60%"). A hand with light green nail polish points to each lens in succession, and small blue lights shine on the lenses to demonstrate their function. The video then cuts back to the woman on the street, who continues speaking and makes a pointing gesture with one finger.

A person with a yellow beanie, gold-rimmed glasses, and a black and white checkered scarf stands on a busy city street, talking excitedly to the camera. They are wearing a grey jacket over a light purple top and have a light blue backpack strap visible. Behind them, a modern glass-fronted building with the red text "JINS" is prominent. Other pedestrians can be seen walking on the sidewalk and a few vehicles are on the street. The person expresses disbelief and surprise with their facial expressions and hand gestures. At the 0:09 mark, white lines radiate from the person's head, and the Japanese character "何 (Nani)" meaning "What?" appears. Shortly after, at 0:13, more Japanese text overlays the screen, reading "彼女はなんと言った？ (Kanojo wa nan to itta?)" which translates to "What did she say?". The person continues to speak with a wide-eyed, incredulous expression, emphasizing their surprise at the 30-minute waiting time for their new glasses.

The video opens inside an optical store, showing a woman with long reddish-brown hair, wearing a grey blazer, sitting in front of a large white eye-testing machine. She leans her face into the machine's viewport as an assistant's hand points to a small screen on the machine. A tablet on the table next to the machine displays red and white patterns. Through the large window, a city street is visible with a white car, pedestrians, and building signs, including "iCracked" and "1F 2F" (meaning 1st floor and 2nd floor). The scene then transitions to the woman, now wearing a yellow beanie, round glasses, and a black and white checkered scarf, standing on a city street and talking to the camera. She gestures with her hands, and behind her is a modern glass building with "JINS" written in red, indicating the name of the optical store. The video briefly returns to the woman inside, using the eye-testing machine, then back to her on the street explaining the process. Finally, the woman is seen inside the JINS store, standing in front of shelves displaying various eyeglass frames. She picks up a pair of round, red-framed glasses, puts them on, smiles, and looks directly at the camera.

In a well-lit modern retail space, a woman with long reddish-brown hair, wearing thin gold-framed round glasses, a grey jacket, and a black and white checkered scarf, looks directly at the camera and speaks. Behind her, a staircase with light-colored steps and glass railings ascends, and a fire extinguisher is visible on the wall to the left of the stairs. As she continues to speak, the camera subtly pans slightly to the right, revealing more of the store's interior with various product displays and other customers in the background. From 0:09 to 0:19, white text on a semi-transparent dark banner appears at the bottom left of the screen, stating: "Tip: Take glasses off with both hands or from the centre, and don't wear them on your head to maintain proper alignment."

A woman with long reddish-brown hair, wearing round glasses and a black and white checkered scarf, walks directly towards the camera, talking with an animated and happy expression. She is moving through a busy urban street, likely a shopping district in Japan, as indicated by the Japanese text on various signs and the appearance of the buildings and people. On her left, people are walking on the sidewalk, some wearing face masks, and a white vehicle briefly passes by. A prominent blue sign with the text "iCracked" is visible on a building. On her right, there are modern storefronts with large glass windows, one displaying items on shelves inside, and more pedestrians can be seen walking. The camera, seemingly handheld, moves forward with the woman, capturing the dynamic street scene as she speaks.

A woman with long red hair and round, gold-rimmed glasses, wearing a grey top and a black and white checkered scarf, walks along a bustling city street while talking to the camera in a selfie-style shot. She smiles and gestures slightly as she speaks. The background shows an urban environment with multi-story buildings, storefronts, and various pedestrians walking in different directions. A black car drives past her on the left side of the street. On the right, a large red poster is visible from 0:08 to 0:12, featuring an image of a breaded cutlet dish and Japanese text that reads "かつや" (Katsuya - a Japanese restaurant chain specializing in Tonkatsu) and "ミラノ" (Milano - Milan). Further down the street, two white vending machines with colorful drinks are visible on the right side from 0:19 onwards, adding to the urban Japanese setting. The woman maintains eye contact with the camera throughout the segment, walking forward as the background continuously changes.

A woman with long, reddish-brown hair and round, clear-framed glasses, wearing a black and white checkered scarf and a light grey coat, walks along a bustling city street while speaking directly to the camera in a selfie-style shot. Her expression is friendly and engaging as she talks about getting tax-free items. Initially, to her right, a storefront with Japanese text and images of food (possibly fried chicken or dumplings) is visible, along with a bright red sign featuring white Japanese characters. A man wearing a dark coat and a face mask walks past behind her. As she continues to walk, a blue vending machine filled with various drinks comes into view on her right, with a red sign above it displaying "2F" and "26" (likely indicating "2nd Floor" and a number). The street is lined with tall buildings, some featuring more Japanese signage. Another man in a light-colored jacket walks from the right side of the frame, passing behind her. Further down the street, a green sign with Japanese text (possibly "TOKYU HANDS") is visible, along with a red traffic light in the distance. She passes a white building with black window frames and what appears to be a metal mesh barrier or scaffolding on her right side. Throughout the segment, she maintains eye contact with the camera, gesturing subtly as she explains her shopping experience and the benefits of tax-free purchases in Japan.

The video segment begins at 0:03 with a blurred shot of a person, likely a woman, wearing glasses and smiling, with a similarly blurred indoor background. Overlaying this image are three lines of white text with a black outline: "HAVE YOU SEEN THESE VIDEOS YET?", "SUBSCRIBE TO JOIN THE FLOCK!", and "Follow me on Instagram @prettypastelplease" (meaning: These are prompts for viewers to watch more content, subscribe to the channel, and engage on Instagram). From 0:04 to 0:15, the person is no longer visible, and the background transitions to a vibrant pastel gradient featuring pink, purple, light blue, and light green hues. At 0:15, the background abruptly shifts to a darker, more muted gradient, dominated by green-grey and dark purple shades, while the overlaid text remains constant until the end of the segment.
